expectations.text: Distinguishes between full disk and mmap
expectations.evidence: Opening paragraph: 'You switched to full disk storage, which forces every HNSW graph traversal hop to read from disk.' Then explains mmap: 'your data lives on disk but the OS automatically caches frequently accessed pages in RAM. Hot vectors stay in memory, cold ones stay on disk.'

expectations.text: Recommends mmap as the middle ground
expectations.evidence: Section header: 'The Fix: mmap + Scalar Quantization'. Step 1: 'Enable mmap storage' with 'Switch from full disk to mmap (memory-mapped files).' Described as 'the standard production configuration for most Qdrant deployments.'

Step 2: 'Add scalar quantization with always_ram=true' with code showing ScalarQuantizationConfig(type=models.ScalarType.INT8, always_ram=True). Explains: 'the small quantized vectors stay in RAM for the fast initial HNSW search.'
Table shows mmap + scalar quantization: p50 50ms, p95 500ms. States: 'search latency under 500ms is usually acceptable' for a chatbot. Also: 'you should expect 50-500ms latency.'

expectations.text: Does NOT recommend going back to full RAM
expectations.evidence: Explicitly states in Summary section: 'Do not go back to full RAM. Switch from full disk to mmap + scalar quantization with always_ram=true.'
